json.name: !!!Low HP Music
json.author: Unknown
json.description: When your total health (red, soul, black, bone and eternal hearts together) drops to one full heart or less while enemies are still in the room, the iconic Low HP theme from Pokemon Black & White plays and overrides the music until you heal up or clear the room. On The Lost and Tainted Lost it plays whenever their Holy Mantle shield is down.
